name: coursera-progress
title: 进步技能
description: Fetch and display Coursera course enrollment, completion progress, grades, certificates, and upcoming deadlines using the Coursera API. Use this skill whenever the user wants to check their Coursera learning progress, see what courses they're enrolled in, review assignment deadlines, track certificate completions, or get a learning summary. Trigger on phrases like "my Coursera courses", "Coursera progress", "check my Coursera", "what's due on Coursera", "Coursera certificate", "online course progress", or "my enrollments".
